# ChristmasFun.store

ChristmasFun.store sells printable Christmas downloads: digital files delivered instantly by email after checkout, printed at home. All artwork is original. Prices in USD. Contact: ChristmasMagicDesigns@juldd.com

## How it works

- Buy on the site, pay by card through Stripe, and a delivery email with download links arrives right away.
- Files are high-resolution PNG and PDF, sized for standard 8.5 x 11 inch home printing unless a listing says otherwise.
- Editable listings use fill-in PDF fields: open the PDF in any free reader, click the name field, type, and print. No Canva account or special software is needed. A filled sample and an instruction sheet are included.

## Categories

- Santa Letters and Christmas Notes: printable stationery for kids, families, and classrooms (a Teacher License covers unlimited classroom printing).
- Gothmas: dark, elegant Christmas printables - ornaments, gothic winter wall art, greeting cards, gift tags and wrap, and a 25-day countdown with a different cozy prompt on every card.

## FAQ

### How quickly will I receive my designs?
Instantly! As soon as your payment is complete, you'll receive an email with download links to all your purchased designs.

### What format are the designs in?
Free coloring sheets are provided as high-resolution PDF files. Santa Letters and Christmas Notes are PNG files. All designs are optimized for printing on standard 8.5" x 11" paper.

### How do I personalize an editable design?
Right inside the PDF - no Canva account and no special software needed. Open the editable PDF in any free PDF reader (like Adobe Acrobat Reader, or the PDF viewer built into your web browser), click the name field, type your names or message, and print. Every editable listing also includes a filled sample so you can see the finished look, print-ready files, and a short instruction sheet.

### Can I use these in my classroom?
Yes! With the Teacher License, you can print unlimited copies for your students and use them in classroom activities.

### Can I resell or share the digital files?
No. These are for personal or licensed classroom use only. You may not resell, redistribute, or share the digital files.

### What if I have printing issues?
We recommend printing on white cardstock for best results. If you experience issues, contact us at ChristmasMagicDesigns@juldd.com
